description: This file defines the 'catalog' module for PySpark, providing classes and methods to interact with Spark's catalog API, including listing, creating, dropping, and managing databases, tables, functions, and cache states.

classes.name: Catalog
classes.description: User-facing API for interacting with Spark's catalog, wrapping the JVM implementation.

classes.name: CatalogMetadata
classes.description: NamedTuple representing catalog metadata with name and optional description.

classes.name: Database
classes.description: NamedTuple representing a database with name, catalog, description, and location URI.

classes.name: Table
classes.description: NamedTuple representing a table or view with attributes like name, catalog, namespace, description, type, and temporary status.

classes.name: Column
classes.description: NamedTuple representing a table/view column with attributes like name, description, data type, nullability, and partition/bucket/cluster flags.

classes.name: Function
classes.description: NamedTuple representing a function with attributes like name, catalog, namespace, description, class name, and temporary status.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the Catalog object with a SparkSession.

methods.name: currentCatalog
methods.description: Returns the current default catalog in the session.

methods.name: setCurrentCatalog
methods.description: Sets the current default catalog.

methods.name: listCatalogs
methods.description: Lists catalogs matching an optional pattern.

methods.name: currentDatabase
methods.description: Returns the current default database.

methods.name: setCurrentDatabase
methods.description: Sets the current default database.

methods.name: listDatabases
methods.description: Lists databases matching an optional pattern.

methods.name: getDatabase
methods.description: Retrieves a database by name.

methods.name: databaseExists
methods.description: Checks if a database exists.

methods.name: listTables
methods.description: Lists tables/views in a specified database, optionally filtered by pattern.

methods.name: getTable
methods.description: Retrieves a table/view by name.

methods.name: listFunctions
methods.description: Lists functions in a specified database, optionally filtered by pattern.

methods.name: functionExists
methods.description: Checks if a function exists.

methods.name: getFunction
methods.description: Retrieves a function by name.

methods.name: listColumns
methods.description: Lists columns of a specified table/view.

methods.name: tableExists
methods.description: Checks if a table/view exists.

methods.name: createExternalTable
methods.description: Creates an external table from a data source (deprecated).

methods.name: createTable
methods.description: Creates a new table in the catalog.

methods.name: dropTempView
methods.description: Drops a temporary view.

methods.name: dropGlobalTempView
methods.description: Drops a global temporary view.

methods.name: registerFunction
methods.description: Registers a UDF (deprecated).

methods.name: isCached
methods.description: Checks if a table is cached.

methods.name: cacheTable
methods.description: Caches a table with optional storage level.

methods.name: uncacheTable
methods.description: Removes a table from cache.

methods.name: clearCache
methods.description: Clears all cached tables.

methods.name: refreshTable
methods.description: Refreshes cache and metadata for a table.

methods.name: recoverPartitions
methods.description: Recovers partitions for a partitioned table.

methods.name: refreshByPath
methods.description: Refreshes cache for a given data source path.
